svg.title: The Agent Factory Stack
svg.desc: Serverless-first, inexpensive to start, scales on demand, no servers to manage. Five layers. Intelligence: Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client runs the model. Protocol: MCP over Streamable HTTP at /mcp with OAuth sign-in, plus MCP Apps screens. Your app, in TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers: the MCP server (createMcpHandler, MCP SDK v2, Zod, step 1), identity with Better Auth (step 4), React widgets (step 9) and skills (step 10). Platform services added as needed: Workers KV (step 2), D1 (step 4), Hyperdrive (step 6), Workers AI (step 8), Durable Objects (step 11), Queues (step 12), Workflows (step 13). System of record: Neon Postgres with row-level security (steps 5 to 7) and pgvector for search by meaning in the same tables (step 8).
